recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If future DeviceUsage corrections are needed, make them in the OO incubator source unless DeviceUsage is brought back into active core build scope.
issue_request: FHIR-51713 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 request to add DeviceUsage.partOf from the Event pattern as 0..* Reference(DeviceUsage), summary=true, with short "Part of referenced device usage", the supplied definition, and a workflow mapping to Event.partOf.
initial_application: Core commit f1b8e124e66f8a524a5d8a47e41f0ed78554c31d added DeviceUsage.partOf and the Event.partOf mapping to source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml. Follow-up commit aeef91f4a000aa7905ce0bb6b99d42b90fc622f0 updated source/deviceusage/deviceusage-event-mapping-exceptions.xml so Event.partOf maps to DeviceUsage.partOf instead of remaining unmapped.
additional_context: Later commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed DeviceUsage from active core fhir.ini resource/workgroup/FMM registration and changed core pages to link DeviceUsage to the OO incubator IG. Current source/device-module.html and source/workflow-module.html point to the external artifact, and the external StructureDefinition JSON includes DeviceUsage.partOf with the requested attributes. FHIR-48918 is related background for DeviceUsage boundaries, and FHIR-43445 later treated DeviceUsage.partOf as an existing workflow mapping while adding other mappings.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because DeviceUsage is outside the active current core build and the external artifact already carries the FHIR-51713 change.
